Traffic Advisory for General Public for 2nd July 2025
---------------------------------
*TRAFFIC POLICE HEADQUARTERS, J&K, JAMMU/SRINAGAR* 

1. From 30-06-2025, 1700 hrs. to 01-07-2025, 1700 hrs., there was slow movement observed on NH-44 due to breakdown of 03 HMVs, single lane traffic at Nashri-Dalwas and between Marog & Kishtwri Pather.
2. *Commuters belonging to Reasi, Katra, Udhampur, Patnitop, Doda and Ramban town are requested to keep their photo ID card to prove their identification after cut off timing from Jammu/Udhampur so that their movement can be facilitated smoothly.* 
3. Passengers/LMVs operators are advised to undertake journey on Jammu-Srinagar NHW during day time due to apprehension of shooting stones between Ramban and Banihal. 
4. Goods carrier (HMV/LMV) Operators carrying fresh perishable/live stock are advised to load their vehicle as per advisory issued by Traffic Police Headquarters time to time as there is single lane traffic and poor condition of road at Nashri-Dalwas and between Marog & Kishtwari Pather on Jammu Srinagar NHW. 
5. *Fruit growers/ Load carrier (HMV/LMV) Operators carrying fresh perishable from Valley towards Jammu are advised to load and park their vehicle timely (every morning before 9.00 am at designated place between NAVYUG Tunnel and Levdoora)*
6. HMVs Operators/Owners are requested to desist from overloading and carry sufficient fuel during journey on Jammu-Srinagar NHW. It is further requested that vehicle owners must double check the fitness of their vehicles and carry sufficient fuel before undertaking journey on Jammu-Srinagar NHW. 
7. HMVs with only 06 and 10 tyres shall be allowed to ply through Dhar road.
8. Commuters are advised to avoid unnecessary haltage between Ramban and Banihal especially near landslide/shooting stone area.

Part of the reason why I'm excited as $GRAB shareholder, the company has $8.7B Cash. It can invest and grow the business to expand its SuperApp Ambition. It is profitable and FCF+ with no debt, so it has very little constraint. Drone delivery is what @amazon is investing in heavily right now. Drones are manufactured cheaply in SEA. Before you jump into conclusion, drone delivery can be very profitable in:

4. Medical deliveries are very much in high demand as aging population in SEA is needing this badly.
5. Grocery.

Alright, here is the article

Kevin Tan, Grab’s @AnthonyPY_Tan  Tan launch PH’s first drone delivery

Alliance Global Group CEO Kevin Tan and Grab boss Anthony Tan are taking logistics to new heights—literally—as they unveil the Philippines’ first-ever drone delivery service.

The groundbreaking pilot will take off in two of Megaworld’s premier townships: Eastwood City in Quezon City and Arcovia City in Pasig.

This pioneering initiative, backed by the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) and the Department of Transportation (DOTr), aims to cut through urban congestion by using drones to fly food and parcel deliveries across the Marikina River.

The river will serve as a controlled aerial corridor, allowing unmanned aircraft to bypass traffic-clogged roads and dramatically reduce delivery times.

Under the program, a Grab rider will collect orders from selected partner merchants and bring them to a designated drone station. From there, the drone will ferry the goods across the river to another drop-off point, where a second rider will complete the final leg of the journey to the customer.

“We’re always looking for meaningful ways to innovate and enhance the customer experience. Partnering with Grab on this pilot allows us to explore how technology can bring greater ease and efficiency to our communities,” said Tan.

The project reflects a bold shift in last-mile delivery solutions at a time when Southeast Asian cities are facing surging demand for fast, efficient logistics amid worsening traffic conditions.

With its unique blend of airspace planning, smart infrastructure, and tech-enabled coordination, the drone delivery initiative in Metro Manila could become a blueprint for similar urban solutions across the region.

Source: BILYONARYO. COM

Subject to fair weather and better road conditions *SANJY convoy/LMVs Passenger/Private Cars shall be allowed from both sides* on Jammu-Srinagar NHW (NH-44) viz from Jammu towards Srinagar and vice-versa.

 *However, HMVs shall be allowed on alternate days* . TCU Jammu/Srinagar shall liaise with TCU Ramban before releasing this traffic.

 *In view of SHRI AMAR NATH JI YATRA 2025* 

 *CUT OFF TIMINGS FOR LMVs/PASSENGER/PRIVATE CARs: -* 
To be released from:-
•Nagrota (Jammu) towards Srinagar: from *0600 hrs. to 1200 hrs*.
•Jakheni (Udhampur) towards Srinagar: from *0700 hrs to 1300 hrs* &
•Qazigund towards Jammu: from 1130 hrs to 1400 hrs. 
TCU Jammu and TCU Srinagar will inform all concerned about the traffic advisory and cut off timings.  

*No vehicle shall be allowed to move before and after cut off timings.*

UT administration has decided all tankers of Petrol, Diesel, LPG bulk gas, all  trucks carrying empty LPG Cylinders; all empty vehicles of FCI; any other vehicle loaded/empty upto 10-tyres shall use only Mughal Road while returning to Jammu.*
